name: Fall Flog
description: Feed qi from the handle to the tip in one pulse as the arm throws so the whole lash carries force.

name: Popperscreen
description: Pulse qi into a loop circling the wrist so the thong turns thrown missiles aside without tiring the arm.

name: Fleet Thong
description: Glide forward along the flight of the thong so the body arrives at the target just behind its tip.

name: Sure Lashend
description: Let the tail tip trail along the floor and read vibrations through the thong to locate unseen movement.

name: Acrid Lashcore
description: Lay the lash along the seam of an opponent's armor where qi gathered at the tip splits the stitching.

name: Thongscreen
description: Hook the tip behind an elbow and drag with a burst of qi so the opponent's strike veers wide.

name: Gripping Keeper
description: Throw a loop that settles over the wrist like a cuff and close it with a short tug.

name: Lassoing Popper
description: Catch the hand that holds a sword inside a loop and clamp it so the blade cannot swing freely.

name: Dense Plait
description: Plant the feet wide and lock the elbow so that a bound foe cannot drag the whip hand forward.

name: Slinking Furl
description: Take a long step backward on the pull so the tightened thong draws the opponent along behind.

name: Keepertonic
description: Hold a slack line lightly in two fingers and feel the faintest tremor of a struggling captive.

name: Levering Snap
description: Wrap a weapon shaft and twist the handle while qi stiffens the thong to wrench the grip open.

name: Tetherprop
description: Keep qi flowing through the wrapped thong while turning the handle so the captured arm is slowly twisted behind the back.

name: Snapslap
description: Begin the rolling cast with an outward lash whose recoil is already loading the next stroke.

name: Cruel Lash
description: Carry the thong around in a second loop so that it lands from an angle the first stroke hid.

name: Guarding Whiptail
description: Roll the thong in a wheel across the front so a stabbing weapon is carried off to the side.

name: Coasting Tether
description: Slide the rear foot up to the front on each cast so the body keeps pace with the rolling thong.

name: Kindly Whipstock
description: Rest the thong across the shoulder between casts and read the opponent's breathing in the lull.

name: Viselike Plait
description: Roll the thong along the ground into the stride of a runner so the ankle catches and the footing is lost.

name: Raw Popper
description: Link three casts with no pause between them so qi never leaves the thong and each stroke lands harder.

name: Brutal Flick
description: Spin the wheel twice then end on a qi-boosted crack that stuns the ears and halts any advance.

name: Plaitswat
description: A single hard snap of the cracker in front of the opponent holds them back for a breath.

name: Emberpopper
description: Bring the cracker down at an angle so its fine edge nicks exposed skin instead of merely slapping.

name: Wild Popcrack
description: Draw the thong across the target as the arm retreats so the stroke slices on the way back.

name: Hazefall
description: Snap the cracker against an incoming blade at the moment of contact and knock it off its path.

name: Rill Lash
description: Step forward on the cutting stroke so the body follows the thong into striking distance.

name: Regimen Fall
description: Stand with the cracker loaded behind the hip so any rush meets an instant snap at the face.

name: Honed Whiptail
description: Crack beside the head to draw the guard up then cut low through the gap the guard has left.

name: Momentfurl
description: Drive qi into the cracker so its report rattles the chest and breaks the rhythm of a charging foe.

name: Keeper Swat
description: Pack qi into the last finger-length of the thong so it slices through a leather collar to the skin.

name: Harsh Tether
description: Throw a light lash that only just brushes the opponent so the exact limit of reach is learned.

name: Rough Flick
description: Throw the whole arm and body into the stroke so the tip lands at the last inch of the thong.

name: Rooted Whipheel
description: Pull the thong home the instant it lands so it returns to guard before a counter arrives.

name: Shielding Whipstock
description: Let the returning thong sweep across the front and knock aside whatever followed it in.

name: Fallhurdle
description: Hop backward after each stroke so the opponent must cross open ground to answer it.

name: Whipheel Tonic
description: Close the off hand on the thong a short way down and feel how much length remains in hand.

name: Stalwart Lashend
description: Brace the whip arm against the ribs with a breath of qi so heavy recoil does not shake the guard.

name: Lurching Lashcore
description: Send a surge of qi to the tip so the strike lands a full pace beyond the thong's own length.

name: Thong Buckle
description: Recall the stretched thong with a snap of qi so it strikes aside a counter that was already in motion.

name: Harsh Whipstock
description: Turn the returning thong into a second cut that meets the foe's counter in the middle of its stride.

name: Sprig Lash
description: Throw the thong in a spiral around both wrists as they rise and cinch the spiral shut.

name: Sleet Popper
description: Wrap the thong twice around a spear shaft and lock the turns so the point cannot be withdrawn.

name: Sturdy Plait
description: Keep the empty hand raised before the face while the bound foe is held at the end of the line.

name: Furl Curl
description: Walk a circle around the bound foe so the thong winds tighter and the opponent turns with it.

name: Gapplait
description: Read the pull in the bound line to know whether the captive is yielding or about to lunge.

name: Clutching Snap
description: Keep qi pressed into every turn of the wrapped thong so the binding tightens a little each second.

name: Entangling Whiptail
description: Bind one wrist then cast the free end to the other and jerk the thong so both arms are drawn together.

name: Gripping Popcrack
description: Form a standing loop in the air with the wrist and drop it over a target's head or arm.

name: Fallbuckle
description: Keep a wide loop turning before the chest so it interrupts any weapon entering the circle.

name: Keen Popcrack
description: Open the loop all at once so the stored swing becomes a straight snap against the target.

name: Lithe Thong
description: Step out of a charge while the loop is still turning so it follows the opponent's line.

name: Thonglinen
description: Feel how much the loop sags under its own length and adjust the next throw to the weight.

name: Gripping Lashcore
description: Drop a lazy loop at the feet so the opponent steps over it and ignores the real line above.

name: Viselike Keeper
description: Throw a loop charged with qi that grips tight on contact before the target can pull free.

name: Whipheel Prop
description: Keep a loop circling an opponent's weapon arm with steady qi so the arm cannot rise past the elbow.

name: Keeperflog
description: Crack behind the opponent's heels the way a drover urges a beast so they step forward unwillingly.

name: Tether Swat
description: Flick the thong across the line of the face to turn the opponent to one side.

name: Springing Furl
description: Walk beside the opponent's line with long even strides and keep the thong trailing at the flank.

name: Plaitcordial
description: Stand easy with the thong draped and watch every shoulder in the crowd for the first sign of a break.

name: Thongscorer
description: Crack with qi at the flank of a group so that they bunch away from the sound.

name: Snapprop
description: Lay a charged lash along the rear leg and pull sideways to swing a stubborn opponent off their line.

name: Honedtether
description: Send the plaited tip straight out with a stiff wrist so the first stroke is the plain one.

name: Crimson Flick
description: Turn the wrist half a circle in mid-throw so the tip curves around the outside of the guard.

name: Brassfall
description: Spin the wrist quickly in small circles so the braid forms a blur that blocks glancing blows.

name: Rill Fall
description: Turn the wrist and hips together so the body slips away on the same arc as the thong.

name: Gapkeeper
description: Feel the twist of the braid under the fingers and learn how far the wrist may turn before it binds.

name: Clutching Popper
description: Wind the thong around a held weapon with a corkscrew turn and pull so the weapon spins from the hand.

name: Cometfall
description: Spiral qi along the braid so the tip threads between raised arms and stings the chest behind them.

name: Shielding Lashend
description: Rotate the wrist against the direction of a thrown blade so the braid catches and spins it away.

name: Splice Plait
description: Steer the tip with the wrist around a shield rim and tug the shield out of line.
